properties.name: result_keys_and_types
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: set(result.keys()) == {'basic', 'plus', 'pro', 'grand_total'} and all(isinstance(v, float) for v in result.values())
properties.description: The returned dict always contains exactly the four tier keys with float values.

properties.name: non_negative_values
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: all(v >= 0.0 for v in result.values())
properties.description: Every summarized total value is non-negative for valid quote lists.

properties.name: two_decimal_precision
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: all(v == round(v, 2) for v in result.values())
properties.description: All returned values are rounded to at most two decimal places.

properties.name: order_independence
properties.description: Summarizing the reversed input list produces the identical result.
